messages:
Taylor: quick follow-up from the postmortem 1: pulled the recurrence clusters and sketched a minimal action plan. heatmap: https://internal.redwood/pm/noise-heat :mag:
Jordan: nice. what's the lowest-risk change we can ship this week?
Taylor: three small bets: 1) kvcache dedupe canary, 2) auth-db threshold bump + hysteresis, 3) non-pager soft alerts for model oom spikes for 48h.
Priya: I'll own kvcache dedupe. plan: canary in low-traffic region -> monitor suppression_rate + missed_alert_estimate -> promote. ETA canary results Tue AM. :thumbsup:
Jordan: I'll handle auth-db thresholds. proposal: move alert from 95th->99.5th pctl, add 3m hysteresis and a soft alert channel for context. PR by Thu.
Taylor: Priya, add an "allow_urgent_if" gate so we never suppress large error surges. also add dashboard tiles + slack webhook for suppression_rate and missed_alert_estimate.
Priya: sample canary snippet I tested locally (pseudo):
```
policy: kvcache-dedupe-canary
group_by: request_prefix
window: 180s
max_pages: 1
allow_urgent_if: error_rate > 0.2
```
Priya: will push as a canary and run synthetic churn.
sre-bot: Created task INF-5301 "kvcache dedupe canary" assigned to Priya, due 2026-04-10.
Jordan: safety metric idea: if missed_alert_estimate >= 0.01 for 20m OR suppression_rate > 0.9 for 30m -> auto-rollback + page infra-oncall. add to runbook.
Taylor: agreed. also include a manual override for service owners and clear rollback steps in the PR description.
Priya: timeline recap: Priya (kvcache canary) Tue AM results; Jordan (auth thresholds PR) Thu; Taylor (runbook + dashboard) EOD today. weekly follow-up: Wed 09:00 20m.
Jordan: paging policy tweak: Critical -> 2 pings then escalate after 5m; High -> single page then suppress duplicates for 20m and notify service-owner; Medium -> channel only. will draft exact text.
Taylor: please include acceptance criteria: top-5 duplicate pages down 50% in 14d and estimated missed alerts < 1%.
Priya: deploying canary now to canary-1. will post initial suppression_rate snapshot in ~30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Taylor: thanks. I'll update the postmortem action tracker with owners, tickets, dashboard links, and rollback criteria before EOD. ping me if blockers. :white_check_mark:
